COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Advocacy in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Advocacy in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Advocacy in the Community as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community.

4. Which statement about Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.
   B. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   D. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Building Resilience is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Building Resilience as rumours only.
   C. Say Building Resilience never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience.

7. Which statement about Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen.
   C. Say Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.
   B. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.

9. Which statement about Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship.
   B. Say Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup.

   A. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices.
   B. Treat Making Important Choices as rumours only.
   C. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Implementation and Reflection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation and Reflection.

   C. Treat Implementation and Reflection as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Building Resilience and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
